messages:
Maria K: quick async standup from night shift — what I did / blockers / today

Maria K: status: saw embed-ingest spike in eu-west1 around 02:15 UTC, regen queue climb from 120 -> ~820, tail latency up ~3x for small prompts
Maria K: mitigation applied: scaled dedicated pool +1 for eu-west1, enabled fallback routing to cheap-variant (quant8) for non-critical routes, increased kvcache retention for short prefixes
Maria K: immediate blocker: one client job keeps re-ingesting the same batch (suspect bad retry logic) — I paused the job (job id: job-1298) but need ownership to fix retries

Ashwin P: noted. which service is the job coming from? can you paste the job id and the offending log line?

Maria K: job-1298 from ingestion-worker-3, sample log: `ERROR retrying bulk ingest: status=409 duplicate_id` — looks like client side doesn't backoff
Maria K: I left the job paused (`./control pause job-1298`) and added a short alert to pager for repeat attempts :warning:

Jordan R: thanks, re: regen queue — I pushed a temporary capacity bump on the autoscaler policy for loader-pool (scale_limit +2) and dropped batch_size from 64 -> 32 for the heavy path to lower tail latency
Jordan R: PR is out: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4321 (small autoscale tweak), will merge if no objections in 30m

Sanjay: I can take the client-side followup in the morning, will contact the partner and ask them to implement exponential backoff. I'll also add a rule to detect rapid re-ingest patterns and auto-block duplicates

Maria K: next steps for incoming oncall: keep eu-west1 pool at +1 until 08:00 UTC or until regen queue <200 for 15m continuous, monitor token spend on quant8 fallback (cost bump but prevents outages)
Maria K: logging pointers: `kvcache.metrics.regen_queue` and `serving.latency.p95` — set a quick dashboard if you don't have it

Ashwin P: noted. I'll set a temporary dashboard and add a one-line playbook in #eng-oncall-playbooks with the threshold checks and the `./control` commands

oncall-bot: Alert resumed: eu-west1 regen_queue cleared to 140 at 02:41 UTC (was 820). Recorded metric snapshots to incident log #INC-2026-84

oncall-bot: Deployment window: autoscaler tweak PR deployed at 02:30 UTC to canary (3 nodes), no errors observed in canary logs

Maria K: wrap-up: paused job-1298 (needs owner), eu-west1 scaled +1 and autoscale PR in canary, fallback model active for low-priority routes, regen queue trending down. If you're taking next shift, please confirm you can keep the pool scaled and assign job-1298 to whoever owns partner-ingest.

Jordan R: taking next shift. I'll keep pool scaled and follow up with Sanjay on the job owner in morning. ping me if regen_queue creeps back up >300 for 10m

Sanjay: thanks — will coordinate with partner ops and post update by 07:30 UTC.

Maria K: thanks team, leaving notes in the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/INC-2026-84/notes — good handoff :thumbsup:

(reacted :eyes: by Jordan R)
